summary: Iteration 32: Proposal Subsections Testing. Backend: 12/12 tests passed - all proposal CRUD with subsections, termos_gerais, photo upload with section_key, PDF generation (comercial/tecnica), and informar P.O. working correctly. Frontend: Code review verified correct implementation of nested sections/subsections. Playwright automation limited due to React Native Web TouchableOpacity (known limitation from iterations 27-31).

integration_issues.flow: Playwright button clicks on React Native Web
integration_issues.issue: React Native Web TouchableOpacity components don't respond to standard Playwright click events. This is a known limitation documented in iterations 27-31. The green '+' button and blue add-section button are visible but not clickable via Playwright.
integration_issues.note: Code review confirms all UI elements are correctly implemented. Manual testing required for full UI verification.

integration_issues.issue: When navigating directly to /admin/propostas, API calls return 403 because AsyncStorage token isn't available immediately. This is a race condition between page load and auth context initialization.
integration_issues.note: Known issue from iteration 29. Workaround: Login first, then navigate.

critical_code_review_comments: Frontend propostas.tsx correctly implements nested sections with subsections (lines 134-180)
Index section shows correct numbering: sections as 1, 2, 3 and subsections as 1.1, 1.2, 2.1 etc (lines 500-526)
Termos e Condicoes Gerais appears as last numbered section with editable text area and default text (lines 614-634)
Save function correctly maps subsections in payload (lines 222-254)
Photo upload supports section_key parameter for sections ('0') and subsections ('0.0') (lines 182-220)
Backend update_proposal correctly preserves subsections during updates (server.py lines 3542-3560)
Backend PDF generation includes subsections in both comercial and tecnica types
All data-testid attributes are present for testing: add-proposal-btn, add-item-btn, add-subsection-{idx}, etc.
